name: topencode
description: TUI + tmux + opencode: manage multiple opencode projects & sessions as mouse-driven tabs, attachable over ssh

scripts.install:local: bun run build && mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && cp dist/topencode ~/.local/bin/.topencode.new && mv -f ~/.local/bin/.topencode.new ~/.local/bin/topencode && echo 'installed to ~/.local/bin/topencode'
